Payout of 10 July is short ₹54.66.
The bank credited ₹44,640.09 against an expected ₹44,694.75. 12 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000013 of ₹54.66, issued 17 July against payment pay_000193. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000013 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000013 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
